program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=program_dir/'task-52dc17b9.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]
    if not rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(rows)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = r - bottom
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            nc = c + shift
            if value and 0 <= nc < width:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out
'''
